fact: In 2020 the Minister of Finance published the Banking (Money Transmission, Mobile Banking and Mobile Money Interoperability) Regulations, under which mobile network operators must be licensed by POTRAZ and have their services recognised under the National Payment Systems Act, and the 2017 Reserve Bank guidelines required mobile money providers to interoperate with banks through ZIPIT.
title: Complexities of competition regulation in Zimbabwe's mobile money sector
publisher: African Journal of Information and Communication
